profile.name: Fenil Rami
profile.headline: Python Backend & Full Stack Developer (React & Django)
profile.statement: I build role-based business web applications and platforms with Django and React, from REST API design to production interfaces.
profile.supportingLine: Developer behind the CMHP multi-company pharmaceutical ERP and the HR University academic platform. Turning real-world operational workflows into clean, reliable software.
profile.about: I'm a final-year Information Technology student and Python Backend & Full Stack Developer. I independently architected and built the complete React frontend for CMHP Pharma ERP—a multi-company pharmaceutical system covering HRMS, orders, dual-ledger inventory, digital BMR batch manufacturing records, and GST invoicing—and engineered the modern web platform and Django REST backend for HR University. My focus is on turning real operational workflows into clean, role-isolated, and reliable software. Additional work includes an Interior Design Studio web portal with OTP authentication and client portfolios, alongside attendance and recruitment pipelines.
